stem_book: A solid sphere of mass m (radius negligible compared with the radius of the cup) is released from rest from the rim of a hemispherical cup so that it rolls along the surface without slipping. If the rim of the hemisphere is kept horizontal, find the normal force exerted by the cup on the ball when the ball reaches the bottom of the cup.
reason: assumption added: sphere radius ≪ cup radius (book's answer uses R for the centre's path)
work: mgR = (7/10)mv² ⇒ v² = (10/7)gR; N = mg + mv²/R = mg + (10/7)mg = 17mg/7
